description: Noise source — blue, white, pink, red and Gaussian, each at its own output, all at once

inputs.text: A separate circuit: a signal here comes out with its negative half folded positive, which turns bipolar noise into unipolar CV

outputs.text: White noise, equal power at every frequency
Pink noise, falling as one over frequency
Red noise, falling as one over frequency squared; also called brown
Gaussian noise, normally distributed about zero
A separate circuit: a signal here comes out with its negative half folded positive, which turns bipolar noise into unipolar CV
Blue noise, rising in power with frequency

menu: Polyphony channels — the number of channels the outputs carry, Monophonic or 2 through 16
